priority: code ascending among supplied frozen event picks; no return-based choice
cash: Only prior-day exit proceeds available at new entry; no same-day recycling even for opening exits
same_code: Reject entries if a prior accepted position is still held, including its exit day
equity: Daily raw close times economic factor relative to entry; full roundtrip cost reserved in open-position mark and realized once at exit
purpose: Compare enhanced and baseline streams under the same capital and position constraints if event-study nominees show promise
limitations: fixed-notional economic-return overlay, not lot-sized broker/account simulation
no rank3 refill and no regenerated downstream signals after a cash skip
daily close drawdown only; no intraday drawdown
stress fee can change subsequent cash acceptance
uses current catalog and adjustment-factor revisions
